# Per-kind line counts of every fixture that is not a diagnostic dump file,
# taken with the parser as it was before it knew diagnostic dump sections (the
# commit that adds section.go; `mtkprof lint` of that build). TestFixtureKindsUnchanged
# holds the parser to these numbers: a section tracker must not change the kind of
# any line of a 10046 or 10053 file. One line per fixture: the path from the repository
# root, the line count, the file kind, then the kinds with their counts (in the order of
# the kind numbers; a kind that is not there has none).
